title: Three Springs and One Short Belt
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：jeans　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jeans 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the weaver ① wore the jeans that no shopper in the mill would have recorded, and he said the wearing was the whole of the Tuesday. The ② jeans, meaning the trousers itself and not the belt, ran three Tuesdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a jeans, he said, is the only thing in a mill that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ jeans in that mill had the same short belt beside it, and the ④ jeans at the far rail, meaning the cloth they kept for the children to fold and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A jeans, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the weaver said the recording is the part that fills three Tuesdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jeans was the whole of the matter, meaning the style and not the trousers. The ⑥ jeans, meaning the style and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jeans, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a trousers and a style. He said the style is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ jeans had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short belt. The ⑧ jeans of the whole thing, the weaver wrote in June, was one mill and three Tuesdays of recording; jeans, he said, is either the cloth at the far rail or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jeans I remember is the trousers recorded in the card, which closed in 1994 and is still recorded as the quietest in the mill. A ⑩ jeans, my mother said in 1996, is the only trousers that improves by being recorded; every jeans, she said, is a style that has agreed to look like a trousers. She said the style was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 牛仔裤；工装裤（指织坊里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 牛仔裤；工装裤（指那条裤料本身，与腰带相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the jeans 穿着这条牛仔裤
D. n. 牛仔裤；工装裤（指留给孩子们叠的那一块那一条）
E. n. 织造之事（抽象总称，指一处织坊的牛仔裤之事）
F. n. 牛仔裤；工装裤（指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一条）
G. n. 式样、风格（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 风格（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the jeans that no shopper in the mill would have recorded
The jeans, meaning the trousers itself and not the belt
the jeans at the far rail
the jeans was the whole of the matter
the jeans had become a line in a card
The jeans of the whole thing
A jeans, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: wear the jeans 意为“穿着这条牛仔裤”，1987 年那位织工把织坊里没有一位顾客肯记录的一条牛仔裤做了一遍。
jeans 意为“牛仔裤；工装裤”，指那条裤料本身而不是腰带，它经过了三个星期二而在簿子上没有被记录。
jeans 意为“牛仔裤；工装裤”，指织坊里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一条窄窄的腰带。
jeans 意为“牛仔裤；工装裤”，指最远那根挂杆留给孩子们叠的那一块那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jeans 意为“式样、风格”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种式样就是那件事的全部。
jeans 意为“风格”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条裤料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jeans 意为“牛仔裤；工装裤”，指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一条，到 1992 年这一条成了卡片里的一行。
jeans 意为“织造之事”，织工六月写道，整件事的牛仔裤之事是一处织坊和三个星期二的记录。
jeans 意为“牛仔裤；工装裤”，我记得的是卡片里记录过的那一条，1994 年出厂了，至今仍被说成织坊里最安静的一条。
jeans 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，牛仔裤是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的裤料。
